title: Document exact lookup for triple-line source complements
body:
## Scope

This adds a computer-assisted, exact-rational lookup result for the one-line and intersection-one two-line triple complements in the original OpenAI manuscript preserved in the repository Douglas Colkitt maintains. Its motif section credits the underlying degree-one intersection construction to Alon. A paper adjacent-exterior contraction reduces every valid ordered elimination to one of 1,936 support/gap skeletons of height at most 11. The included standard-library checker enumerates those normal forms exactly and verifies a fixed table of 20 matrix values and 17 nonzero operation coefficients. The reference has `h-r` pivots in `h` row iterations, including every valid `h=100` source instance.

The note derives the correct coefficient `(3*1_{j in L}-1)/6` from `G=I-J/9`, proves the all-retained-row contraction at complete pivot blocks, and distinguishes the paper induction from the finite certificate. It credits the upstream source form and records a bounded current-source overlap check, with no priority claim. The local Tintagel audit packet is unpublished provenance; the proof and checker needed for the scoped claim are in this PR. The patch was prepared with substantial AI assistance.

## Replay

```sh
python3 -I -B research/tintagel-source-lookup/replay.py --stress
```

Local replay of files exported from commit `b6869aecced795ae6ce1ea4a0360cab6165bc8ed` passed: 1,936 skeletons, 65,416 word records, 11,584 pivots, the exact 20/17 tables and digest `adf555d553a11c9f2862ddf6a7206fd03428ec657763f60f9aecfc6d4850ec7d`, plus 6,090 finite compression stress cases. The checker also guards the h=5 counterexample `row_b=(-4,2,2,-1,0)` to an invalid stronger row-state claim; the proof uses only the column invariant. The portable patch passed `git apply --check` against main `db0e57bc7f36b5ac0fc844ad7ce1396165ee6647`. A bounded Opus review did not execute the checker and suggested that false stronger claim. A subsequent independent exact-commit review caught it. Final re-review accepted the corrected invariant, attribution and exact three-file delta; it independently replayed the exported checker, including the counterexample guard. This is a bounded content review, not a formal proof.

## Boundary

The all-height claim rests on a paper induction plus finite computation; the induction is not mechanically checked. This does not execute the full `h=100` physical source graph, establish its arithmetic primitive implementation or charges, link the Q>11 recursive pivot child, or provide packed/phase/native/root/global composition. It is not a Lean proof, a full provider, or a new multiplication exponent. The fixed-source-`W` grouping scope, S0-transformed-input premise and exceptional repair terms remain open. Publication preflight rechecked upstream main and related PR descriptions; its bounded search found no matching lookup submission.
